description: Read the site's worklog: append-only entries recorded by previous agent or human rounds, newest first. Each entry lists what changed (kind + summary) and the evidence it points at (audit run, finding, finding state, page, proposal, doc), plus optional next actions. Use it before starting a new round so you do not re-litigate decisions or re-discover fixes; the audit findings remain the source of truth for current state. Requires the audit:read scope.
name: get_site_worklog
title: Read what previous rounds changed
